proof.ordered: For the alternating ordered string cdag(a1)c(b1)...cdag(an)c(bn), Wick contraction matrix has P(bi,aj) when i>=j and -Q(bi,aj) when i<j, Q=I-P. Determinant permutations have sign(-1)^(n-cycle_count+upward_edges). Each permutation cycle contracts to trace(A_i C_ij A_j C_jk ...), with C_ij=P if i>=j elseQ. This reproduces Tr(PAQB) with PLUS for a two-factor connected contraction, not a plus occupied substitute.
proof.copies: An ordered word of summed even bilinears across N identical independent auxiliary Slaters is a sum over set partitions of factor labels. Each block keeps its original relative order and lies in one copy. Distinct blocks choose distinct copies: falling factorial(N,block_count), NOT N^n for every Wick block. Active and auxiliary even algebras commute, so their subsequences factor without a fermionic sign. N63 is literal when used by the campaign.
proof.gaussian: Initial real129 Gaussian DENSITY variance2, Fourier momentum variance1/8. For a right-normal polynomial after e^(iqTheta), Fourier overlap shifts its Gaussian momentum mean to -q/2 and multiplies by exp(-q²). Thus linear momentum means are -q_r.q/2 and covariances q_r.q_s/8. Exact rational Gauss Gram can supply these inputs; Wick recurrence is only this initial Gaussian integral, never an evolved state claim.
proof.scope: Caller supplies INITIAL occupied projector(s), exact right-normal operator order, actual Ref3 constant and raw four-channel weights.
